content_analysis.summary: A 10-second character-reveal title trailer for a stylised anime heroine. It is not a story trailer — it is a graphic-design performance: the character is repeatedly introduced by, through, and inside oversized typography. Every one of the twelve shots is a poster that moves, and the character's job is to collide with the layout.
content_analysis.target_audience: social/short-form audience for anime, idol and streetwear brand content
content_analysis.hook_technique: Print artefact first (registration marks, barcode, colour bar) so the viewer reads 'poster', then violate the poster by letting a character move through it. The reveal is withheld — eye macro, silhouette, back-of-head — and the full body lockup is saved for the last 2.5 seconds.
content_analysis.call_to_action: none — it ends on a static logo lockup

color_palette.overall_mood: Two-accent risograph/duotone discipline on an achromatic base. Never more than two accents in a frame.

style_profile.typography_observed: Single family, heavy grotesk in ALL CAPS (Helvetica/Archivo Black territory), tracked tight, set enormous — often bleeding off-frame. Supporting layer of 6-8px technical micro-type, barcodes, QR, ►►► chevrons and crop marks. No serifs, no scripts, no gradients on type.
style_profile.music_style: no dialogue; percussive SFX bed — whooshes, impacts, glass, risers, synced to the cuts
style_profile.subtitle_style: none — all text is design, not captions
style_profile.playbook_delta: Needs a print/editorial layer the stock playbook has no vocabulary for: registration marks, halftone dot fields, barcodes, colour-calibration bars, and above all TYPE-AS-OCCLUDER (character depth-interleaved with letterforms). That last one is the signature move and must be built bespoke.

key_elements_to_replicate: 12 shots in 10s — avg 0.83s, rapid_fire, every cut on a beat
one hero glyph per shot, set huge, frequently bleeding off-frame
character depth-interleaved with type (behind one letter, in front of the next)
strict two-accent palette on an achromatic base
print artefacts as a persistent layer: crop marks, barcode, micro-type, colour bars
final 2.5s static lockup — the payoff is a poster, not a motion flourish
silhouette / partial / withheld reveal before the full-body reveal
elements_requiring_custom_work: type-as-occluder depth interleaving (no stock scene-type does this)
halftone dot field and registration/crop-mark furniture
the character artwork itself — needs a cut-out subject with alpha
creative_differentiation_seeds: Swap the idol/streetwear register for neo-noir crime: the user's three posters are a different genre entirely.
Swap magenta+lilac for crimson+bone on a black ground — same two-accent discipline, opposite temperature.
Swap butterfly particles for cigarette smoke, rain, and neon bokeh.
Swap the 'FULL SPEED / NO BRAKES' velocity verbs for a cold procedural register: coordinates, film stock codes, case numbers.
Replace the character's athletic motion with stillness — in noir the subject barely moves; the LAYOUT moves around him.

playbook_customizations.add_layer: print/editorial furniture (registration, halftone, barcode, colour bars)
playbook_customizations.motion_law: cuts land on beat; within a shot, one dominant move only
playbook_customizations.type_rule: one hero glyph per shot, tracked tight, allowed to bleed

five_aspect_shot_breakdown.reading: Print-registration plate: off-white paper, crop marks, barcode, a black rule sliding in from both edges, a magenta circle punching on. Wordmark 'BTS' snaps into the circle in black. Subject: N/A (pure graphic). Camera: locked, no move. Overlays: crop marks, barcode, micro-type.

Hard cut to macro live-action eye, with a giant white 'S' glyph laid over it so the letterform occludes the face. Spatial framing: ECU. The glyph is a foreground layer, not a texture — the key trick of the piece.
Shatter: the eye frame breaks into magenta/lilac polygonal shards that fly at camera. Transition, not a scene.

Black field, giant white 'BTS' in heavy grotesk. The character (anime girl, white tracksuit, black/pink hair) runs THROUGH the letters — passing behind the B, in front of the T. Depth interleaving of character and type. Pink butterfly particles + spark bursts trail her.
Triptych: three vertical panels (magenta / white / lilac) each with a rotated 'FULL SPEED' side-bar and the same silhouette in a different pose. Pure graphic-design frame, no photography.
Circular lockup: 'NO BRAKES NO LIMITS' set on a ring around the character, ring counter-rotates while she kicks out of the centre; magenta butterfly burst.
White card, black 'JUMP' in condensed caps; the character lands on a coil spring that physically deforms the 'M'. Type is treated as a physical object.
Lilac field split by a black diagonal band; outlined ghost-type 'FLIP' behind; character does a flip along the diagonal. Diagonal is the composition's motion vector.
White card, 'PINK' in magenta over 'FAST' in black, character crouches in front of the words, partially covering 'FAST'. Then re-stacks to 'FAST / ARMY / BTS'.
Black field, wireframe perspective grid, character small and centred, targeting reticle + HUD micro-type drawing on. Technical/blueprint interlude.

Glass-pane break: 'B-T-S' in white behind glass panes that shatter as the character bursts forward at camera. Cut to a 3-up poster grid (01/02/04, barcodes, QR, magenta circle) that slides horizontally.

Endplate: white studio, character lands from a handstand, concentric magenta/lilac rings draw around her, debris settles, then the final lockup — 'BTS' in heavy black with the character standing INSIDE the letterforms, butterfly badge, barcode, halftone dot field, ►►► chevrons. Holds ~2.5s.

_analysis_meta.agent_vision_pass: completed — 12 scene keyframes + 40 dense frames at 4fps reviewed by the agent
